as_told.title: Kona Blue failed special access program

plain: Kona Blue is described as a secret US government project about UAP, which stands for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's newer name for UFOs. Jesse Michels, a podcast host, mentions it on one episode as a program that was released, he thinks, by accident. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb gives a fuller version on a later episode. He says Kona Blue was proposed in 2010 as a special access program, meaning a highly restricted secret project, but that it never got off the ground. He credits AARO, the Pentagon's current office for investigating UFO reports, with releasing the slide presentation about it. He also names people he links to it: Glen Gaffney, Robert Cardio and Rob Jones. The tellers find it notable because, if true, officials once tried to set up a formal secret program dealing with UFOs.
